name: Kimino (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Kimino town emblem in navy and green: a navy disc with a green leaf and a white curved stroke.
history: Municipal flag of Kimino, a town in Wakayama Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 January 2006.

features.role: Kimino town emblem — a navy disc with a green leaf and a white curved stroke
